items.exampleEn: My son is afraid of dogs.
Why are you angry with me?

items.exampleZh: 我叔叔會講好笑的故事。

items.exampleEn: It is a pleasure to meet you.

items.sentenceEn: Reading is a pleasure for me.
items.sentenceZh: 閱讀對我來說是一種樂趣。

items.audioEn: Don't be angry. I am sorry I am late.
items.audioZh: 別生氣，很抱歉我遲到了。

items.sentenceEn: We heard a cry from the street.
items.sentenceZh: 我們聽到街上傳來一聲叫喊。

items.stemEn: He is very ____. He always gets good grades.
items.stemZh: 他很聰明，總是拿到好成績。

items.passageEn: Today is Jack's birthday. His friends have a surprise party for him. When Jack comes home, everyone jumps out. Jack is afraid at first. Then he laughs and says, "What a surprise! It is a pleasure to have smart and funny friends like you."
items.passageZh: 今天是 Jack 的生日。他的朋友們為他辦了一場驚喜派對。Jack 一回到家，大家就跳了出來。Jack 一開始很害怕，接著笑著說：「真是驚喜！有你們這些聰明又有趣的朋友，真是我的榮幸。」

questions.questionZh: 朋友們為 Jack 準備了什麼？
Jack 一開始有什麼反應？

referenceEn: Why are you angry with me?
rubricZh: 問原因用 Why 開頭，be 動詞放在主詞前面（例如 Why are you…?）
生某人的氣可加 with（例如 angry with me），沒加也正確

items.instructionZh: 用 funny 造一個句子，說說好笑的人、電影或故事。
referenceEn: I watched a funny movie with my friends.
rubricZh: funny 放在 be 動詞後面或名詞前面（例如 is funny、a funny movie）
